title: 上大学啦
slug: 冰糖炖雪梨全本免费-冰糖炖雪梨最新章节列表
content_zh:
棠雪擦着霖城联大的分数线被录取, 但她的分数够不上自己填的专业，于是被调剂去了兽医专业。
也是这个时候她才知道，原来大学里还有兽医这种专业。
棠校长有些担忧：“兽医不就是给母猪催奶的吗？难道你以后要进养猪场给母猪催奶？啊不行不行, 我一想那个画面我就头晕……你给我好好学习，争取走学术路线吧，以后进高校可以当老师, 教别人怎么给母猪催奶。”
棠雪并没觉得学术路线有更靠谱。
不过她天生心大, 也就眼黑了那么一下下，之后该吃吃该玩玩, 浪完剩下的暑假, 拖着行李箱开开心心地上学去了。
兽医专业又怎样呢, 至少“霖大”这块牌子说出去, 还是很可以装装X的。
棠校长不放心, 跟着她一起上了高铁。
同行的还有棠雪的高中同学, 廖振羽。
廖振羽和棠雪当了三年同学，基本算是棠雪的小马仔，平常都喊棠雪“老大”, 不过在棠校长面前他不敢造次, 怕老大被老大的爸爸骂。
所以就只能喊她名字，“棠雪”两个字从他嘴里讲出来时别别扭扭的，很不习惯。
棠校长就觉得这廖振羽有问题，扭扭捏捏的样子，搞不好又是想拱自家小白菜的猪，这都不知道是第几头了，呵呵。
他老人家就状似不经意地透露了一下自己年轻时玩散打的经历。路上遇到小混混，一拳头下去，小混混哭着报警了；丈母娘家杀鸡不用刀，他拧一下鸡脖子，鸡就断气了……
廖振羽在旁听得心惊肉跳，讲话都快变结巴了。
棠校长有些满意。
棠雪坐在窗边，手撑着下巴，看窗外飞速掠过的风景，高铁的速度太快了，她看得有点头晕，扭了扭脖子，她说：“好无聊啊，廖振羽，要不你转专业吧？”
廖振羽呆了一下：“转、转什么？”
“转到兽医专业来啊，我一个人多无聊。”
坐在俩人中间的棠校长听完这话，都想给她脑袋上来一巴掌了：“人家好好的医学院，你让他转兽医？别胡闹。”
“兽医怎么了呀？反正都是看病，给人看给猪看不都是救死扶伤吗。再说了，你看电视上那些新闻，给人看病有可能被人打，给猪看病，猪会打你嘛？”
棠校长被她的歪理邪说震惊了，一时又找不到词辩驳，指着她说：“你，你这，你这个……混蛋！”

棠雪有些委屈和惆怅，趴在面前的小桌板上，嘟着嘴小声说：“我是怕，又一个人走散了啊……”
棠校长愣了愣。
廖振羽说：“老……老……棠雪。”
棠校长有些不高兴地看他一眼：“你怎么叫她‘老棠雪’？我女儿很老吗？”
“啊？不不不不是，我的意思是……棠雪，我看过地图，农学院和医学院离得不远，我们还可以一起吃饭和自习。”
“嗯，好吧。”棠雪趴在小桌板上点了一下头。
从湖城到霖城的高铁是三个多小时。棠校长陪两个孩子办好入学，安排好宿舍，在霖大的食堂吃了顿晚饭，然后他要坐晚上的高铁回去。
棠雪想把他送去高铁站，棠校长死活不肯。
在校门口分别的时候，棠校长又嘱咐她：“你好好学习，争取保研，硕博连读更好，当然了想出国也行，你放心咱家有钱的，现在进高校都要博士以上了，啧啧……”他还惦记她的学术道路呢。
“爸爸，我觉得你越来越唠叨了。”
棠校长转过身，在心里默默地叹了口气。
因为爸爸老了啊。

content_en:
Tangxue passed the score line and was admitted to Lincheng United University, but her score was not up to the major she applied for, so she was transferred to the veterinary school major.
It was also at this time that she learned that there was a major in veterinary medicine in the university.
Principal Tang was a little worried: "Aren't veterinarians just for inducing lactation for sows? Are you going to go into a pig farm to inducing lactation for sows in the future? Oh no, no, I get dizzy when I think about that scene... You should study hard and try to take the academic route. In the future, you can be a teacher in college and teach others how to induce lactation for sows."
Tang Xue did not feel that the academic route was more reliable.
However, she was born with a big heart, so her eyes only darkened for a moment. After that, she spent the rest of her summer vacation happily dragging her suitcase to school after it was time to eat and play.
So what about the veterinary profession? At least the "Linda" brand can still be fake.
Principal Tang was worried and followed her on the high-speed rail.
Also accompanying him was Tang Xue’s high school classmate, Liao Zhenyu.
Liao Zhenyu and Tang Xue have been classmates for three years, and they are basically Tang Xue's little pony. He usually calls Tang Xue "boss", but he dare not make a mistake in front of Principal Tang, for fear that the boss will be scolded by the boss's father.
So he could only call her by her name. When the word "Tang Xue" came out of his mouth, it was awkward and he was not used to it.
Principal Tang felt that there was something wrong with Liao Zhenyu. He was acting coy and coy. Maybe he was another pig that wanted to win over his little cabbage. He didn’t even know which pig he was, haha.
The old man seemed to casually reveal his experience of playing Sanda when he was young. I met a gangster on the road and punched him. The gangster cried and called the police. My mother-in-law's family didn't use a knife to kill chickens. He twisted the chicken's neck and the chicken died...
Liao Zhenyu was so frightened when he listened that he almost stuttered when speaking.
Principal Tang was somewhat satisfied.
Tangxue sat by the window, holding her chin with her hand, looking at the scenery passing by quickly. The high-speed train was so fast that she felt a little dizzy. She twisted her neck and said, "It's so boring, Liao Zhenyu, why don't you change your major?"
Liao Zhenyu was stunned for a moment: "Turn, what?"
"I'll switch to veterinary medicine. I'm so bored by myself."
After hearing this, Principal Tang, who was sitting between the two of them, almost wanted to slap her on the head: "I have a good medical school, and you want him to switch to veterinary medicine? Don't be ridiculous."
"What's wrong with the veterinarian? After all, you're just treating patients, and looking at pigs is not saving lives. Besides, if you watch the news on TV, you might get beaten when you treat people, but if you treat pigs, will the pigs beat you?"
Principal Tang was shocked by her fallacies. He couldn't find the words to defend himself, so he pointed at her and said, "You, you, you... bastard!"
Tangxue felt a little aggrieved and melancholy, lying on the small table in front of her, pouting and whispering: "I'm afraid, I got separated again..."
Principal Tang was stunned.
Liao Zhenyu said: "Old... old... Tang Xue."
Principal Tang looked at him a little unhappy: "Why do you call her 'Old Tangxue'? Is my daughter very old?"
"Ah? No, no, no, no, I mean...Tang Xue, I have seen the map. The Agricultural College and the Medical College are not far away. We can also eat and study together."
"Yeah, okay." Tangxue nodded while lying on the small table.
The high-speed train from Hucheng to Lincheng takes more than three hours. Principal Tang accompanied his two children to enroll in school, arrange their dormitories, and have dinner in Linda's cafeteria. Then he would take the high-speed rail back home in the evening.
Tangxue wanted to send him to the high-speed rail station, but Principal Tang refused.
When they were saying goodbye at the school gate, Principal Tang told her again: "Study hard and try to secure a postgraduate degree. It would be better to study for a master's degree and a Ph.D. degree. Of course, you can also go abroad. Don't worry, our family is rich. Now you have to have a doctorate or above to enter a university. Tsk tsk..." He was still thinking about her academic path.
"Dad, I think youGetting more and more nagging. "
Principal Tang turned around and sighed silently in his heart.
Because dad is old.
